AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 21, 2023
  UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
  ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE
LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING:
YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE
ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
 THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
  https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Ana Valencia, Mayor
  Margarita L. Rios, Vice Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Councilmember
  Jennifer Perez, Councilmember
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
 Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
 the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
 subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
 minutes.

 Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
 certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
 matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

 Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

 Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
 meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
 devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
 documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
 Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
 that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

 Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
 has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

 Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
 during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
 telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  CLOSED SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Valencia

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION
  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(2) –
  Significant Exposure to Litigation in one case.

RECESS

REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Valencia

INVOCATION
  Pastor Miguel Martinez
  First Baptist Church of Norwalk

FLAG SALUTE
  Hailey Rodriguez
  Waite Middle School

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to recognize the Holiday Home and Business Décor Contest winners.

  II.  City Council to Proclaim February as National African American History month.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Homeless Count 2023 video.

  3.  Bi-Weekly Review.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of February
  7, 2023. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 22, 2023 –
   February 4, 2023, in the total amount of $1,072,272.65. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  January 31, 2023 through February 13, 2023, in the total amount of $2,461,139.21. 640

  Report

  4.  RESOLUTION NO. 23-13 - DESTRUCTION OF OBSOLETE RECORDS – CITY CLERK,
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT, AND FINANCE DEPARTMENTS - Staff recommends City Council
  adopt Resolution No. 23-13, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AUTHORIZING THE DESTRUCTION OF CERTAIN RECORDS IN THE CITY CLERK, COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT, AND FINANCE DEPARTMENTS. 870-02

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – FEBRUARY 8, 2023 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Report

  6.  ASSEMBLY BILL 361 FINDINGS - Staff recommends City Council make the following findings:

  a.  City Council has reconsidered the circumstances of the state of emergency.

  b.  Both of the following circumstances exist (i) The state of emergency continues to directly impact
  the ability of the members to meet safely in person and (ii) City Council continues to impose or
  recommend measures to promote social distancing including remote or hybrid meeting
  participation. 825

  Report

  7.  AGREEMENTS TO PROVIDE ON-CALL ENGINEERING DESIGN, CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT,
  PROJECT MANAGEMENT AND STAFF AUGMENTATION SERVICES - Staff recommends City
  Council approve agreements with the ten selected firms: Onward Engineering, Kimley-Horn, WGZE,
  FCG Consulting, DMS Consultants, Mark Thomas, SA Associates, Civiltec, Arcadis, and PSOMAS, to
  provide on-call design, construction support, project management, and staff augmentation services for
  a term of three years from the date of execution; and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreements and any amendments provided there is funding in the budget, and it is within the City
  Manager’s signing authority, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

  8.  FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION CERTIFICATIONS AND ASSURANCES FOR FEDERAL
  FISCAL YEAR 2023 - Staff recommends City Council authorize the Executive Director of Regional
  Transportation to execute the Fiscal Year 2023 Certifications and Assurances Federal Transit
  Administration Assistance Programs/Affirmation of Applicant, file grant application(s) on behalf of the
  City and execute a grant agreement(s); in concurrence with and execution of the Affirmation of
  Applicant’s Attorney Certification by the City Attorney. 1105-01

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  9.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

  10. HOMELESS PLAN ADHOC COMMITTEE - Staff recommends City Council select two members to
  serve on the Homeless Plan Adhoc Committee.
   Report

PUBLIC HEARING

  11. RESOLUTION NO. 23-09 - GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 183 TO UPDATE THE HOUSING
  ELEMENT OF THE GENERAL PLAN FOR THE SIXTH CYCLE (2021-2029) - Staff recommends City
  Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 23-09, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 183; and

  b.  authorize staff to transmit the adopted Housing Element to Department of Housing and Community
  Development. 320-02-01-183/320-02-03
  RESOLUTION

  Report

RESOLUTION

  12. RESOLUTION NO. 23-10 - FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW AND REVISIONS;
  AND RESOLUTION NO. 23-11 - AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 SALARY SCHEDULE FOR
  GENERAL AND HOURLY UNIT EMPLOYEES AND EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT AND MID-
  MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES - Staff recommends City Council adopt:

  a.  Resolution No. 23-10, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AUTHORIZING AMENDMENTS TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 BUDGET; and

  b.  Resolution No. 23-11 – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2022/23 SALARY SCHEDULE FOR
  GENERAL AND HOURLY UNIT EMPLOYEES AND EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT AND MID-
  MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES.  610

  Report

REPORTS

  13. AGREEMENT FOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN, ENGINEERING, AND FINAL CONSTRUCTION
  DRAWINGS  FOR  FACILITY  TENANT  IMPROVEMENTS  -  PHASE  III  AT  THE
  TRANSPORTATION/PUBLIC SERVICES FACILITY - Staff recommends City Council approve an
  agreement with Stantec Architecture, Inc. for Architectural Design, Engineering, and Final Construction
  Drawings for Facility Tenant Improvements at the Transportation/Public Services Facility in the amount
  of $637,100.38 from February 22, 2023 through December 31, 2024; and any amendments provided
  there is funding in the budget and it is within the City Manager’s signing authority, on behalf of the City,
  in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1120-10

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 16, 2023.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
